subject: Request: Net-90 + Quarterly Invoicing concession for Cascadia Labs (pilot)
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Net-90 + Quarterly invoicing concession for Cascadia Labs (pilot)

Hi Marissa / Priyom —

Quick ask: Cascadia Labs (Victor & Lydia copied below) is asking for a one-time concession to move to Net-90 payment terms and quarterly invoicing for the first 12 months of their contract. Background: they are a regional diagnostics provider; we agreed to a 12-month pilot at $360,000 ARR equivalent (monthly usage + platform fee), 3-year SOW option. Legal has approved the limited redlines in the attached SOW.

Why they're asking: cashflow seasonality from grant funding — they can pay quarterly, but only on 90-day cycles. Sales/CS have proposed mitigations (listed) to reduce risk. We need executive/finance sign-off because this deviates from standard terms and exceeds the usual 60-day exception.

Ask (one-liner): executive approval for Net-90 + quarterly invoicing for the first 12 months with the following conditions:
- 25% prepay deposit collected at signing
- Early-pay 2% discount if paid within 15 days of invoice
- Finance to place account on monitoring & weekly collection cadence; reserve right to revert to Net-30 on missed payment
- Contract clause: pilot review at 6 months to revert terms if risk threshold crossed

Attachments: Cascadia_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW with redlines), cascadia_cashflow_model.xlsx (sales/finance cashflow impact)

Quick summary of stakeholders:
- Sales (me) — need to keep deal moving; customer sensitive to upfront asks
- CS (Grace) — will run onboarding and monitor usage/collections
- Finance (Priyom) — final sign-off on credit terms

If you want a one-page risk memo I can send — but asking for a quick decision so we can get DocuSign to them before the end of next week.

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Subject: Re: Request: Net-90 + Quarterly invoicing concession for Cascadia Labs (pilot)

Sean — thank you for the context and the attachments. I pulled the ARR math and cashflow model; two immediate flags: the deal size is material and the proposed Net-90 extends beyond our standard Net-60 approval threshold for commercial.

Suggested escalation path: Priyom (Finance) to weigh in on whether the 25% prepay + early-pay incentive is sufficient and whether we need a corporate guarantee or PO. If Finance is comfortable, I recommend adding a conditional holdback clause in the SOW (5% retainer to be released after first two invoices clear). That gives us immediate recovery if collections slip.

Also: please confirm whether Account Exec can collect the 25% deposit prior to routing to DocuSign; legal has made the SOW edits so signing should be straightforward once finance approves.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head, Revenue Operations
marissa@redwood.com

Team — I reviewed the cashflow model and ran a quick credit check. Recommendation: approve Net-90 and quarterly invoicing on a 12-month pilot basis with the following firm controls:

1) 25% prepay at signing (collected by Sales before DocuSign finalization).
2) 2% early-pay discount if invoice paid within 15 days.
3) Add 5% conditional holdback in SOW to be released after second on-time payment.
4) Finance will open a weekly collection touchpoint with CS and the customer; if any invoice is >30 days overdue beyond the agreed window we revert to Net-30 and pause provisioning of optional modules.
5) Require purchase order or signed PO-equivalent prior to billing.

This approval is timeboxed: valid for this one SOW / deal id CAS-2026-041 only; Finance will re-evaluate at 6 months. If the customer meets payment milestones we can consider standardizing to Net-60 thereafter.

Sean — please confirm you've secured the 25% deposit and the PO. Grace — please set up the collection monitoring cadence once they sign. I'll route a short approval note to Legal to confirm SOW language for the holdback.

Priyom Das
Head of Deal Desk / Finance Policies
priyom@redwood.com
